Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Applause is a leader in software testing and digital quality. As our Sr QA Tester for Payments, you will be an integral part of our Client Partner's QA organization to facilitate the full end-to-end coverage of all manner of payment instrument (PI) transactions. This will certainly include all NFC enabled iOS devices and potentially, various Android devices.
An ideal candidate possesses stellar interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail and enjoys close collaborations across cross-functional teams.
 Basic terms:
Working days and hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 4 PM CET 
Office address: TNO3 Building, 4th Floor, 165 Splaiul Unirii,București 030133. 
 Responsibilities:
Conduct release and ad hoc testing of payment transactions on a variety of devices/OS 
Write test plans, test cases 
Execute test case driven and exploratory testing 
Log found defects for tracking 
Organize and analyze testing data for trends and customer reports 
Communicate with client staff about the status and progress of testing projects 
Assist the QA Test Lead to provide regular reporting that includes test artifacts and metrics for payment testing 
Assist the QA Test Lead to manage a Transaction reconciliation process related to transaction processing for review and cancellation after successful verification 
Respond to Production teams reporting a payments issue to validate successful operation or else to find root cause of the reported issue 
Work with US Based Global Payments Lead and other Applause team members globally; coordinate with other on-site and remote Applause team members to ensure that coverage is always available during Production Support hours from 9 AM - 8 PM CET. 
 Qualifications, experience and skills we are looking for:
3+ years of QA manual functional testing 
Bachelor's degree in CS, Engineering or other technical domain 
Strong collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners 
Nice to have: Prior experience QA testing of Payment Instruments and transactions 
 Compensation :
The gross annual salary range for this position is 140,000 to 180,000 RON.
